create_sparse_coordinator: create a sparse coordinator with config, algorithm, backend adaptor, and token pools for sparsity management
parse_hisparse_config: parse a hisparse configuration JSON string from server args into a SparseConfig object with defaults
register_sparse_coordinator: register a SparseCoordinator instance as the global sparse coordinator for the runtime
get_sparse_coordinator: retrieve the currently registered global SparseCoordinator instance or None if not set
create_sparse_algorithm: create a sparse algorithm instance (quest or deepseek_nsa) from a SparseConfig and device
